Advance.name: Advance
Advance.flavor: You press forward, one deliberate step at a time.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You move up to your Speed in squares, in one piece: the movement you don't use is lost (you can't move part of it, use another Action and move the rest later). Once during this Advance, at any point of the movement, you can use the Interact Action (paying its 1 AP then) and go on moving.

Aid.name: Aid
Aid.flavor: You call the opening, and a friend takes it.
Aid.target: One ally that can hear you

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Quickened 1 on its next turn.

body.label: Special
body.text: If the target is Daunted, you also make an Appeal or Instinct Check against the Action DC of the Action that Daunted it: on a Tier 2 or 3, the target is no longer Daunted.

Aim.name: Aim
Aim.flavor: Patience turns a good shot into a sure one.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Make a [Ranged] Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon. It ignores [[Cover|Low cover]].

Armor of Faith.name: Armor of Faith
Armor of Faith.flavor: Each time you answer for an ally, your god's light settles on you like mail.

body.label: Passive
body.text: When you use a [Divine] Reaction (not Judge's 0R), you gain Guard equal to 1 + your Power Modifier.

Avenge Kin.name: Avenge Kin
Avenge Kin.flavor: Touch its kin, and the orc answers.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: An ally within 2 squares takes damage from a [Strike] Action.

body.label: Tier 2 or 3
body.text: It attacks the attacker, if it can reach it.

Backhand.name: Backhand
Backhand.flavor: You stepped inside its reach as if it weren't looking.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: An enemy enters a square adjacent to the ogre.

body.label: Effect
body.text: It takes [V] 1 Bl and is Pushed 2, with no roll. Its movement isn't disrupted: it goes on with the movement it has left.

Barbed Javelin.name: Barbed Javelin
Barbed Javelin.flavor: The orc throws a short spear that stays in the wound.

Basic Attack.name: Basic Attack
Basic Attack.flavor: You strike with the weapon in your hands.

body.label: Special
body.text: You attack with the weapon you are wielding. Basic Attack takes the Melee or Ranged trait of that weapon, and its Range.

Battering Charge.name: Battering Charge
Battering Charge.flavor: Nothing slows you down once you start running.

body.label: Passive
body.text: When you use Charge, your Speed counts as 2 higher for its movement, and its Weapon Attack (1A) is [[Empowered]].

Beacon.name: Beacon
Beacon.flavor: You plant your feet, and light rims the shoulders of everyone near you.
Beacon.target: You and allies in the Area

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 3 rounds, you and allies in the [[Aura]] gain +1 Defense. While the Beacon is active, you gain the following Action:

body.label: Special
body.text: **Beacon's Step** — 0R | Round | Interrupt: An ally in the Aura takes damage. | Effects: You Evade 1 toward the ally.

Bear the Blow.name: Bear the Blow
Bear the Blow.flavor: You take the blow on the shoulder they would have taken it on.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: Your Bound Ally is adjacent to you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An Action would damage your Bound Ally.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You gain 1 Guard. You take half of that damage (rounded up); your Bound Ally takes the rest (Chapter 1, Halving and splitting damage). The split is made before Guard: each of you then applies your own Weakness and Guard to your part; **your Resistance and Immunity don't reduce your part**, your Bound Ally's do reduce theirs.

Binding Light.name: Binding Light
Binding Light.flavor: Your blow lands wreathed in light that roots your foe where it stands.

Blade and Bow.name: Blade and Bow
Blade and Bow.flavor: Arrow, knife, arrow: each sets up the next.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on each of your turns, when you use a [Melee, Strike] Action after a [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn, or a [Ranged, Strike] Action after a [Melee, Strike] Action this turn, it gains 1 Boon.

Blood for Blood.name: Blood for Blood
Blood for Blood.flavor: The wound only makes it angrier.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: The target deals Vigor damage to the orc (the blow that makes it Bloodied counts).

body.label: Effect
body.text: The orc Advances up to 2 toward the target, then makes a Basic attack against it with 1 Bane.

Bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
Bloodlust.flavor: The red haze settles, and you stop caring about pain.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 1 round, your [Melee, Weapon] Actions are [[Empowered]] and gain 2 Boons, and you take 1 Bane on Saves.

Bowl Over.name: Bowl Over
Bowl Over.flavor: All the weight of the head, low and through.

Brawler.name: Brawler
Brawler.flavor: Your hands have won more fights than any blade.

body.label: Passive
body.text: You gain the Pummel Action. Your [[Fists]] don't have the [[Non-threatening]] property: you can flank with them.

Break Free.name: Break Free
Break Free.flavor: You tear loose from whatever holds you.

body.label: Check
body.text: Body or Instinct vs. Action DC

body.label: Tier 2 or 3
body.text: You are no longer Immobilized, and no longer Grabbed if you were.

Brutal Swing.name: Brutal Swing
Brutal Swing.flavor: The orc puts its whole weight behind one wild arc.

Bulwark of Faith.name: Bulwark of Faith
Bulwark of Faith.flavor: You step into the blow meant for them, and your god holds the line with you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An enemy's [Strike] Action would damage the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to what one of their Rally Points heals, before the damage. After the damage, they are Slid 1.

Challenge.name: Challenge
Challenge.flavor: You call them out, and they cannot look away.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once per round, when you deal damage to a creature with a [Melee, Strike] Action, you can challenge them: their [Strike] Actions against creatures other than you take 1 Bane (EoT).

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.flavor: You close the distance in one straight, reckless line.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Advance in a [[Straight Line|straight line]] toward the target, at least 3 squares and up to your Speed, and stop on the first square from which the target is within your Reach. You can't Charge through Difficult Terrain (an ally's space is Difficult Terrain) or an enemy's space, even if you have movement left: the Charge ends in the last **empty** square where the line is legal. At the end of your movement, make a Basic Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the target. That Basic Attack counts toward At-will Banes.

Chilling Touch.name: Chilling Touch
Chilling Touch.flavor: Fingers of fog, and the cold goes straight to the heart.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: [R] 1 + 1d4! Co; Daunted of the Grave Wisp (EoT).

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [R] 2 + 1d4! Co; Daunted of the Grave Wisp (EoT).

Circling Shot.name: Circling Shot
Circling Shot.flavor: You circle your foe as you draw, and loose from the side it has left open.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod]; you Evade 1 to a square that is no farther from the target.

Class Expertise.name: Class Expertise
Class Expertise.flavor: You have studied your craft longer than most.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Choose one Encounter or Daily Action from your class's Repertoire that you don't have. You gain it.

Clear Lines.name: Clear Lines
Clear Lines.flavor: Your friends have learned where not to stand, and you have learned to shoot past their ears.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your allies give your targets no Cover, and your [Ranged] Actions take no Field Bane for a target Engaged with one of your allies.

Cleaver.name: Cleaver
Cleaver.flavor: A butcher's blade, swung by someone who enjoys it.

Club.name: Club
Club.flavor: A tree trunk with a handle.

Cold Domain.name: Cold Domain
Cold Domain.flavor: Your god's blessing rests on your weapon as frost.

Commandment.name: Commandment
Commandment.flavor: You speak with your god's authority: you call a foe to face you, steady the hearts around you, or order a foe to its knees.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Taunted by you (1 round).

body.label: Effect
body.text: An [[Aura]] 3 around you (1 round): you and your allies in it ignore the Daunted condition.

Consecrated Ground.name: Consecrated Ground
Consecrated Ground.flavor: You drive your weapon into the earth and the ground around it shines: your foes wade through it, and your allies stand firmer on it.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 3 rounds, the Area is Difficult Terrain for enemies. Whenever you or an ally starts a turn in the Area, that creature gains Guard equal to your Power Modifier.

Cornered.name: Cornered
Cornered.flavor: Hurt, it stops fencing and starts throwing its weight around.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While the orc is Bloodied, its [[Shove]] gains 1 Boon.

Covering Fire.name: Covering Fire
Covering Fire.flavor: You keep the arrows coming down on one stretch of ground, and nobody crosses it without paying.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For 2 rounds, the Area is Difficult Terrain and [[Hazardous Terrain]] for enemies [HT: Entering, Turn, Movement]: [V] damage equal to 2 + your Weapon Modifier, of your weapon's subtype.

Covering Shot.name: Covering Shot
Covering Shot.flavor: You see the blow coming before they do, and your bolt gets there first.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: A [Strike] Action would damage an ally within 10 squares.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Make a [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the attacker. On a Tier 3, the ally takes half of the triggering damage.

Crack the Ground.name: Crack the Ground
Crack the Ground.flavor: It brings the club down two-handed, and the floor gives.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The squares of the Line are Difficult Terrain for every creature (EoE).

Crawl.name: Crawl
Crawl.flavor: You drag yourself along the ground.

body.label: Effect
body.text: **Requirements:** Your Speed is 5 or higher. You move 3 squares.

Crushing Grip.name: Crushing Grip
Crushing Grip.flavor: A hand closes round you like a door shutting.

body.label: Special
body.text: The ogre holds one creature at a time: a new Grab lets the first go.

Cudgel.name: Cudgel
Cudgel.flavor: A heavy stick and no reason to hold back.

Cut Through.name: Cut Through
Cut Through.flavor: You drive through the line without stopping, and strike as you pass.

body.label: Setup
body.text: Evade 2. During this Evade you can move through the space of any creature (you can't end in one), and you ignore Difficult Terrain.

body.label: Critical
body.text: Relocate (1A) the target, ignoring the Handle trait.

Darting Blade.name: Darting Blade
Darting Blade.flavor: You shift the bow to one hand, open a foe with the knife, and are gone before it turns.

body.label: Special
body.text: You make this Strike with a Light weapon you hold.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Evade 2, then can stow the Light weapon you've drawn.

Deadeye.name: Deadeye
Deadeye.flavor: You put everything into one shot, and everything into the one after.

body.label: Critical
body.text: The target is Blinded for 1 round.

Deathmark.name: Deathmark
Deathmark.flavor: One arrow, one name, and nothing left to argue.

body.label: Tier 2 or 3
body.text: Against your [[Marked Quarry]], this Action has 1 Boon. If the target goes Down, you can choose a new Marked Quarry (0R) and make a [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A) against them.

Demoralize.name: Demoralize
Demoralize.flavor: You fix them with a look and a promise, and their guard slips.
Demoralize.target: One creature that can see or hear you

body.label: Special
body.text: The target is immune to your Demoralize until the end of the encounter (EoE).

Dirty Trick.name: Dirty Trick
Dirty Trick.flavor: Sand in the eyes, a heel on the toes, and the goblin is gone.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: [V] 1d4 Pi; 1 Pressure Bane on its next roll.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1 + 1d4 Pi; 1 Pressure Bane on its next roll.

Divine Intervention.name: Divine Intervention
Divine Intervention.flavor: You reach out, and your god answers before you finish the prayer.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: You or an ally within 5 squares would go Down.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Instead of going Down, the creature's total damage becomes 1 less than their Health Pool, and they gain [[Guard]] equal to what one of their Rally Points heals.

Divine Power.name: Divine Power
Divine Power.flavor: Your god's strength flows through your weapon and your hands.

body.label: Passive
body.text: When you deal Holy damage to a creature with the Profane [[Tags|Tag]], that creature takes 1 Bane on its [Strike] Actions (EoT).

Divine Surge.name: Divine Surge
Divine Surge.flavor: You name the foe in your god's sight, and every blade that finds it burns.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, at the start of each of your turns you can name one enemy within 5 squares of you. For 1 round, the first time an ally deals damage to them, they deal an extra [R] 1d8 Ho.

Double Shot.name: Double Shot
Double Shot.flavor: Two shots, so close together they sound like one.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You make two [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attacks (1A), each against a different creature.

Drawing Light.name: Drawing Light
Drawing Light.flavor: A cord of light catches them and hauls them toward you.

body.label: Bloodied
body.text: You can Slide the target that distance instead of pulling it.

Dread Whisper.name: Dread Whisper
Dread Whisper.flavor: It knows your name, and it says what you fear most.

Drifting.name: Drifting
Drifting.flavor: Nothing in its way is quite solid to it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: The wisp's own movement can pass through creatures' spaces (it can't end in one), and a creature's space is never Difficult Terrain for it.

Dying Flare.name: Dying Flare
Dying Flare.flavor: It goes out the way a lamp does when it is dropped.

Evade.name: Evade
Evade.flavor: You slip through the fray without giving anyone an opening.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Evade 1: a movement that doesn't trigger reactions, in one piece; you can't Evade into or through Difficult Terrain (an ally's space you can cross, at double cost).

body.label: Effect
body.text: Evade half your Speed (rounded down): a movement that doesn't trigger reactions, in one piece; you can't Evade into or through Difficult Terrain (an ally's space you can cross, at double cost).

Feint.name: Feint
Feint.flavor: You show one blow and land another.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: You gain 2 Boons on your next [Strike] Action against the target this turn.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: Your next [Strike] Action against the target this turn is Favored.

body.label: Critical
body.text: The target can't use Reactions against you until the end of your turn.

Final Verdict.name: Final Verdict
Final Verdict.flavor: You name every sin within reach, and the light answers all at once.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Signature or Weapon vs. Armor Defense

body.label: Tier 2 or 3
body.text: You roll once and compare the result to each target's AD. Each target you hit is Pushed 1 and sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation for 1 round. A Bloodied target is Prone instead; a Strained target also gains Bleed [R] 1d6 Ho (Mi/Ap).

Finisher.name: Finisher
Finisher.flavor: A wounded thing runs in a straight line.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more, the first [Projectile] Action you make each round that deals damage to a Bloodied or Strained creature deals an extra [V] 1d8 Pi.

Fists.name: Fists
Fists.flavor: When there is nothing else in your hands, there are always your hands.

Fleet.name: Fleet
Fleet.flavor: Nothing on this field is as fast as you are now.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Each Evade of yours moves you 1 more square, and your Evades can enter Difficult Terrain.

Font of Mercy.name: Font of Mercy
Font of Mercy.flavor: Where you kneel, wounds remember how to close.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, when you or an ally within 5 squares of you uses a Rally Point, they heal your Power Modifier + 2 more.

Footwork.name: Footwork
Footwork.flavor: You are never where you were a breath ago: a long sidestep, a run through the press, or a step with your hands already busy.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Advance. During this Advance, Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you, and you can move through the squares of unwilling creatures (you can't end in one).

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Evade 1, and before or after it you use the Interact or Reload Action (1A).

Great Sweep.name: Great Sweep
Great Sweep.flavor: The club goes round at chest height.

Ground Slam.name: Ground Slam
Ground Slam.flavor: The ogre brings both fists down, and the ground jumps.

Guarded Cut.name: Guarded Cut
Guarded Cut.flavor: The blade strikes and comes straight back to guard.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1d10 + [Mod] Sl; you gain +1 Armor Defense for 1 round.

Gut Punch.name: Gut Punch
Gut Punch.flavor: A fist with a blade in it, right under the ribs.

Guttering Glance.name: Guttering Glance
Guttering Glance.flavor: The light goes out behind your eyes.

Hallowed Dawn.name: Hallowed Dawn
Hallowed Dawn.flavor: Dawn breaks where you stand, and it chooses sides.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You and each ally in the Area heal 3d6 + your Power Modifier (4d6 at Stage 2, 6d6 at Stage 3) and end one effect on them that is EoT or has 1 round left. Each enemy in the Area is Pushed 2 away from you, takes 1 Bane on its [Strike] Actions and sheds Bright light in a 1 Emanation for 1 round.

Hallowed Stance.name: Hallowed Stance
Hallowed Stance.flavor: Your god's light carries you: wherever you are needed, you are already there.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on your turn, a [Divine] Action you use gains "Setup: You Advance 3."

Hamstringing Axe.name: Hamstringing Axe
Hamstringing Axe.flavor: The orc cuts low, at the leg that would carry you away.

Hand of Mercy.name: Hand of Mercy
Hand of Mercy.flavor: A single touch undoes what the enemy worked for.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Choose one: the ally ends one effect on them that is EoT or has 1 round left; or, if the ally is Down, they can use 1 Rally Point.

Harrying Shot.name: Harrying Shot
Harrying Shot.flavor: You loose a shot meant to rattle, close enough that they flinch.

body.label: Bloodied
body.text: On a Tier 3, the target is Daunted of you (EoT).

Harrying Shots.name: Harrying Shots
Harrying Shots.flavor: Every arrow says the same thing: not yet.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, the first time each round you deal damage to your Marked Quarry with a [Projectile] Action, they take 1 Bane on [Strike] Actions (EoT).

Haul.name: Haul
Haul.flavor: You snag them and drag them in.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: Your Reach is 2 or more. The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours and is at least 2 squares away. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

Heal.name: Heal
Heal.flavor: You press, bind and talk them back to their feet.

body.label: Tier 1
body.text: The target can use 1 Rally Point.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: The target can use 2 Rally Points.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: The target can use 2 Rally Points, and if it is Prone it can Stand.

Heartseeker.name: Heartseeker
Heartseeker.flavor: A full draw, aimed where the armor gives.

Heavy Blows.name: Heavy Blows
Heavy Blows.flavor: Every swing carries the whole weight of the steel.

body.label: Passive
body.text: When a [Melee, Strike, Weapon] Action you make with a Two-handed weapon deals damage on a Tier 3, it deals 2 more.
**Not written yet.** Hiding and sneaking are an open item (see [[Senses]]). This card holds the place, so that other cards can refer to Hide.

Hit and Run.name: Hit and Run
Hit and Run.flavor: You run the length of the fight with the knife out, opening every foe you pass, and somewhere along the way an arrow leaves your bow.
Hit and Run.target: Each enemy adjacent to you at any point of the Advance, and one creature within your bow's Range

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Advance. After each square of this Advance, you hit each enemy adjacent to you that this Action hasn't hit yet with a [[Light (property)|Light]] weapon. Once, at any point of the Advance, you hit one creature within your bow's Range with your bow. You draw and stow the two weapons freely during this Action.

body.label: Special
body.text: The bow's hit is Doomed if you are Engaged when you make it.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Weapon vs. Armor Defense. Roll once, when the first creature is hit: every hit of this Action uses that roll.

Hold the Line.name: Hold the Line
Hold the Line.flavor: You plant yourself where the fight is worst: you crowd the ground at your feet, trade places with an ally, or carry one clear.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The squares adjacent to you now are Difficult Terrain for enemies (1 round). They stay where they are if you move.

blocks.heading: Trade Places

body.label: Effect
body.text: You and the target swap squares. Each of you is moved by a Reposition.

blocks.target: One willing ally of your Size

Holy Wrath.name: Holy Wrath
Holy Wrath.flavor: For one blow, your god stops holding back.

Hooking Chop.name: Hooking Chop
Hooking Chop.flavor: The beard of the axe catches, and you pull.

Hunter's Edge.name: Hunter's Edge
Hunter's Edge.flavor: You know where it will be before it does.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, your [Projectile] Actions against your Marked Quarry ignore Cover, and the first one each round that deals damage deals an extra [V] 1d4 Pi.

Hunter's Focus.name: Hunter's Focus
Hunter's Focus.flavor: You and the quarry, and nothing else in the world.

body.label: Effect
body.text: For the rest of the encounter, against your Marked Quarry (a new Marked Quarry when you choose one): you gain 1 Boon and are Empowered against them, and you take less damage from each of their Actions, reduced by your **Signature Modifier** (you choose which instance of its damage is reduced).

Hurled Goblin.name: Hurled Goblin
Hurled Goblin.flavor: The goblin has time to look surprised.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: A willing Minion ally is within the ogre's Reach.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The Minion is thrown: the ogre places it in an empty square adjacent to the target (hit or miss). This is not a Reposition or a Forced Movement: it triggers no Reactions, and the Minion takes no damage.

Interact.name: Interact
Interact.flavor: You pull the lever, open the door, grab what you need.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You do one of the following: draw an object you carry into a free hand; stow an object you hold (put it away on your person, such as sheathing a sword); swap two objects (stow the one you hold and draw another, in the same Action; stowing and swapping need no free hand); grab objects within Reach, as many as you have free hands; help a Prone creature within Reach stand up; help an Imperiled creature within Reach get to safety; wake an Unconscious creature within Reach; open a door, chest or something similar. This Action is broader than most: it can be used for similar things in the world. You can use it once during an Advance Action without ending the Advance (see [[Advance]]).

Jeer.name: Jeer
Jeer.flavor: It says something about your mother, in Goblin, and somehow you understand.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [R] 1d4 Ps; Taunted by the goblin (1 round).

Judge.name: Judge
Judge.flavor: You pronounce a foe guilty before your god, and holy light dulls its blows against those who stand near you.

body.label: Judged
body.text: A creature stops being Judged when it goes Down. A creature Judged by you counts as Profane for you. Once each round, when it damages an ally within 5 squares of you, you can reduce that damage by your Power Modifier. Multiple Paladins can Judge the same creature: it is Judged by each of them.

body.label: Special
body.text: You can use this only at the start of an encounter, or as a 0R when the creature you Judged goes Down.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Judged by you (EoE).

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is Judged by you (EoE). If another creature was Judged by you, it no longer is.

Keep Them Off.name: Keep Them Off
Keep Them Off.flavor: The point stays between you and them, and it pushes.

Kickboxer.name: Kickboxer
Kickboxer.flavor: Your legs hit as hard as your fists.

body.label: Passive
body.text: You gain the Leg Sweep Action: a kick, so it needs no free hand. You can use it with your hands full.

Killer's Focus.name: Killer's Focus
Killer's Focus.flavor: First blood is the only blood that matters.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, your first [Projectile, Strike, Weapon] Action each round that deals damage deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.

Kindled Wrath.name: Kindled Wrath
Kindled Wrath.flavor: An ally's blood on the ground, and your god's anger is yours.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once an encounter, when an ally becomes Bloodied or goes Down, your Escalation increases by 1.

Knife in the Back.name: Knife in the Back
Knife in the Back.flavor: You were looking at the other one.

Lantern of Faith.name: Lantern of Faith
Lantern of Faith.flavor: You call your god's light: around you, onto a foe, or into a foe's eyes.

Lay On Hands.name: Lay On Hands
Lay On Hands.flavor: You stride to an ally's side and lay a hand on them, and a skin of pale light settles over them.

body.label: Setup
body.text: You Advance up to 5 squares in a straight line toward the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to 2 + your Power Modifier.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target gains Guard equal to 2 + your Power Modifier and can use 1 Rally Point.

Lean.name: Lean
Lean.flavor: You lean out from cover, just enough to see.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Until the end of your turn, or until you leave your square, you are Leaning: you calculate cover from one of your corners instead of the center of your square, and your own cover against other creatures' Actions is reduced by 1 level. You can stop Leaning at any time on your turn, at no cost.

Lean and Loose.name: Lean and Loose
Lean and Loose.flavor: A wall is a quiver's best friend: you are out, the arrow is gone, and you are back.

Leg Sweep.name: Leg Sweep
Leg Sweep.flavor: A low kick takes their legs out from under them.

body.label: Special
body.text: This Action uses your [[Fists]] even when you have no free hand.

Lesser Blessing.name: Lesser Blessing
Lesser Blessing.flavor: A small gift from the god you follow.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Pick one blessing from the list below, related to a god you follow. You gain its Action. (More blessings will be added.)

Lock & Loose.name: Lock & Loose
Lock & Loose.flavor: A bolt to the knee, and they go nowhere.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: [V] 1d4+2+[Mod] Pi; For 1 round, the creature is Hindered until they use a Move Action.

Long Draw.name: Long Draw
Long Draw.flavor: You pull a little further, and the arrow flies a little truer.

body.label: Passive
body.text: With a [[Projectile]] weapon, your far range has no Bane and your maximum range has 1 Bane instead of 2.

Low Blow.name: Low Blow
Low Blow.flavor: No rules in a back alley.

Lunge.name: Lunge
Lunge.flavor: A full extension that reaches farther than they thought.

Mark Quarry.name: Mark Quarry
Mark Quarry.flavor: One name, one face, and the rest of the field goes quiet.

body.label: Special
body.text: At the start of each encounter, choose one enemy as your Marked Quarry with this Action. You gain 1 Boon on [Projectile, Strike] Actions against them, and those Actions deal [V] [Mod] extra damage (the same subtype as your weapon) on a Tier 1. You can only have one Marked Quarry at a time.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The targeted creature becomes your Marked Quarry: at the start of an encounter, or as a 0R [Focus] when yours died or went Down.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The targeted creature becomes your Marked Quarry instead of the one you had.

Marked Quarry.name: Marked Quarry
Marked Quarry.flavor: You pick the one, and the world narrows.

body.label: Passive
body.text: At the start of each encounter, choose one enemy as your **Marked Quarry**. You gain 1 Boon on [Projectile, Strike] Actions against them, and those Actions deal [V] [Mod] extra damage (the same subtype as your weapon) on a Tier 1. You can only have one Marked Quarry at a time.

Marksman's Shot.name: Marksman's Shot
Marksman's Shot.flavor: One shot, carefully placed. Everything after it is easier.

Mending Light.name: Mending Light
Mending Light.flavor: Light gathers where you stand, and the hurt are drawn to it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, at the start of each of your turns, you or one ally within 5 squares of you heals twice your Power Modifier + your Stage.

Miraculous Recovery.name: Miraculous Recovery
Miraculous Recovery.flavor: You lay both hands on the wound and call in a debt owed to your god.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target heals twice what 1 Rally Point would heal, and you end one non-permanent effect of your choice on them.

body.label: Effect
body.text: As 2 AP, but three times what 1 Rally Point would heal.

Oath of Burden.name: Oath of Burden
Oath of Burden.flavor: You set your shoulder beside theirs: whatever comes for them comes through you.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target is your **Bound Ally** (EoE). If another creature was your Bound Ally, it no longer is. While you have a Bound Ally, you have the Reaction [[Bear the Blow]].

One More Arrow.name: One More Arrow
One More Arrow.flavor: By now your hands move faster than you can think: there is always one more arrow in the air.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once on each of your turns, when a [Strike] Action of yours deals [W] on a Tier, it deals 1[W] more to each creature on that Tier.

Open Season.name: Open Season
Open Season.flavor: You call it, and every arrow in the party finds the mark.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Make a [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A) against your [[Marked Quarry]]. For 1 round, they are Vulnerable 2, and [Strike] Actions your allies make against them deal an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.

Opening Shot.name: Opening Shot
Opening Shot.flavor: Your arrow staggers the foe, and your ally's blade is already coming.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once a round, when you get a Tier 3 with a [Ranged, Strike] Action against a creature, one ally who threatens it can spend 1R to make a Basic Attack (1A) against it.

Opportunity Attack.name: Opportunity Attack
Opportunity Attack.flavor: You punish anyone who moves carelessly near you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An enemy adjacent to you would leave a square during a Move Action or uses the Stand Action.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You can make a Weapon Attack (1A) against the triggering creature, as long as your weapon can target them. An NPC makes its Basic attack instead.

Overhead Smash.name: Overhead Smash
Overhead Smash.flavor: Both hands on the club, and the floor cracks under it.

body.label: Bloodied
body.text: On a Tier 2 or 3, the target is Pushed 1 more.

Overwatch.name: Overwatch
Overwatch.flavor: Nothing moves in your sight without an arrow following it.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: An enemy within 10 squares moves closer to you or to an ally.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Make a [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A) against the triggering creature. On a Tier 2 or 3, it is Hindered (EoT); on a Critical, it is also Pushed 2.

Pass Through.name: Pass Through
Pass Through.flavor: It drifts straight through you, and the cold stays.

body.label: Setup
body.text: The wisp Advances in a straight line; the targets are enemies whose space it passed through.

Pinning Shot.name: Pinning Shot
Pinning Shot.flavor: You pin their foot to the ground with an arrow.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Make a [Ranged] Weapon Attack (1A). On a Tier 2 or 3, the target is Immobilized (EoT).

Point Blank.name: Point Blank
Point Blank.flavor: Too close for a bow. Not too close for this.

body.label: Tier 2 or 3
body.text: While you are Engaged, this attack takes 1 Bane for it instead of 2.

Pummel.name: Pummel
Pummel.flavor: A flurry of blows until something gives.

Quick Shots.name: Quick Shots
Quick Shots.flavor: You loose arrow after arrow into one foe before the first has landed, and step away while it reels.

Radiant Zeal.name: Radiant Zeal
Radiant Zeal.flavor: The longer the fight, the brighter you burn.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, the first [Strike] Action you make each round that deals damage deals an extra [R] 1d6 Ho.

Rain of Arrows.name: Rain of Arrows
Rain of Arrows.flavor: Arrows fall from nothing, again and again, until the ground is gone.

Rally the Tribe.name: Rally the Tribe
Rally the Tribe.flavor: One bellow, and the whole tribe fights harder.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Allies within 5 squares gain 1 Support Boon on their next [Weapon] Action.

Reaping Sweep.name: Reaping Sweep
Reaping Sweep.flavor: A wide, heavy arc for anyone standing too close.

Rebuke.name: Rebuke
Rebuke.flavor: You call out in your god's name, and your foe's stride falters and stops.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: The target moves away from you.

Reckoning.name: Reckoning
Reckoning.flavor: You stride among your foes, and your god's light breaks from you and throws them back.

Regrip.name: Regrip
Regrip.flavor: You shift your hands on the grip, and the weapon sits where you want it.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You do one of the following: hold a weapon you hold in one hand with both hands (your other hand must be free); move a weapon from one hand to the other; or swap the weapons in your two hands. Regrip doesn't have the Handle trait: it doesn't need a free hand.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You drop an object in your square, or let go of an object you hold with one hand (a two-handed weapon is then held with one hand).

Reload.name: Reload
Reload.flavor: You work the mechanism and seat a fresh bolt.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: You or an ally within Reach is wielding an unloaded weapon.

body.label: Tier 1
body.text: Your next Reload attempt gains 2 Boons.

body.label: Tier 2
body.text: You Reload the weapon. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: You Reload the weapon and its wielder can Evade 1. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.

Relocate.name: Relocate
Relocate.flavor: You take them by the arm and put them where you want them.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours. The target must remain within your Reach throughout the whole movement.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Body or Instinct vs. the same Attribute's DC

Rending Chop.name: Rending Chop
Rending Chop.flavor: A blow that splits armor and leaves the flesh open.

Ricochet.name: Ricochet
Ricochet.flavor: You dart wide for the angle, and the arrow skips off one shield into the throat behind it.

body.label: Setup
body.text: You must Advance 2. This Advance doesn't count as leaving your square for other cards.

body.label: Ricochet
body.text: The arrow can bounce to a second creature within 2 squares of the target that the target has Line of Effect to (you don't need Line of Effect to it). It takes half of the damage dealt to the target, before the target's Resistance, Weakness, Immunity and Guard (Chapter 1, Halving and splitting damage), then applies its own; none of the riders. No roll is made against it, and it isn't hit on a Tier: another card's Tier effects (Opening Shot, One More Arrow) don't apply to it.

Rime Strike.name: Rime Strike
Rime Strike.flavor: Frost runs down the edge, and the cold bites before the steel does; where it lands, the ice rises.

body.label: Ice Pillar
body.text: A pillar of ice rises in a square adjacent to the target that holds no creature or object and that you have Line of Effect to (EoE). You have one Ice Pillar at a time: raising a new one melts the old one. It fills its square as a wall does: it blocks movement and Line of Effect through its square, its corners are solid (Chapter 3, Corners), and it gives Cover as a wall does. Its Defense is your Action DC for that Rime Strike (11 + the Modifier its mode used). Against a Save it gets Tier 1. An Area that covers its square hits it, whoever made the Area. It breaks when one Action deals it 5 or more damage; less does nothing and doesn't add up. A creature that collides with it (Chapter 3, Collision) deals it the damage the creature takes.

Rimebrand (Cold).name: Rimebrand (Cold)
Rimebrand (Cold).flavor: Frost creeps along your weapon, a gift from a winter god.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Until the end of your turn, your [Weapon] Actions deal an extra [R] 1d4 Co, and the first one that deals damage on a Tier 3 makes the target Hindered (EoT).

Ringing Blow.name: Ringing Blow
Ringing Blow.flavor: A crack on the helm, and their next swing goes wide.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1d8 + 1 + [Mod] Bl; its next [Strike] Action takes 1 Pressure Bane (EoT).

Roar.name: Roar
Roar.flavor: It turns its whole face toward you and bellows.

Rolling Shot.name: Rolling Shot
Rolling Shot.flavor: You keep moving, and the shot rides along with the motion.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Evade 1, then make a [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A).

body.label: Effect
body.text: Evade 2, then make a [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A) that deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Evade 3, then make a [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A) that deals an extra [V] 2d6 Pi.

Roving Judgment.name: Roving Judgment
Roving Judgment.flavor: Your eye passes from one guilty foe to the next, and your god's attention follows it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: The 1 AP use of Judge costs you 0 AP.

Rusty Knife.name: Rusty Knife
Rusty Knife.flavor: A notched blade, quick and dirty.

Sacred Weapon.name: Sacred Weapon
Sacred Weapon.flavor: You lay a hand on the steel and bless it for what comes next.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You touch a creature (yourself or an ally). They become Empowered for 1 round.

body.label: Effect
body.text: As 1 AP, but you can touch up to two creatures.

Searing Blows.name: Searing Blows
Searing Blows.flavor: Every blow you land leaves a little of the light behind.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, your [Strike] Actions that deal damage deal an extra [R] 2 Ho.

Seizing Cut.name: Seizing Cut
Seizing Cut.flavor: You catch your foe's arm with your empty hand, cut, and turn it to where you want it standing.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: You have at least one hand free.

Shake Off.name: Shake Off
Shake Off.flavor: You beat out the flames, press on the wound, scrape off what burns.
Shake Off.target: You, or one Lingering creature within your Reach

body.label: Effect
body.text: The target makes a Save against its [[Lingering]], with the better of the Lingering's two Attributes, against DC 13 or the DC the Lingering writes. **Tier 1:** no effect. **Tier 2:** it takes half the Lingering at the end of the current turn (whoever's turn it is), then the Lingering ends. **Tier 3:** the Lingering ends.

Shared Burden.name: Shared Burden
Shared Burden.flavor: You swear to carry what falls on them.

body.label: Passive
body.text: You gain the Action [[Oath of Burden]] and the Reaction [[Bear the Blow]].

Sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
Sharpshooter.flavor: You were made for the shot no one else would take.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Choose your Hallmark Action: **Double Shot** or **Rolling Shot**. Choose one [[Projectile]] weapon, such as a bow or a crossbow: you start with **3 Mastery** with it. Your [Projectile] Actions don't take the Bane for targeting a creature Engaged with a creature other than you.

Shield of Faith.name: Shield of Faith
Shield of Faith.flavor: You raise a hand, and a pane of light turns part of the blow aside and pulls your foe's eye to you.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: An enemy's [Strike] Action would damage the target.

body.label: Effect
body.text: That damage is reduced by 1 + your Power Modifier, and the triggering creature is Taunted by you (1 round).

Shifting Aim.name: Shifting Aim
Shifting Aim.flavor: You never loose twice from the same spot: a step to the side, and the line is clean again.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [Ranged, Strike] Actions gain 1 Field Boon if you have left your square this turn since your last [Strike] Action (or since your turn began).

Shiv.name: Shiv
Shiv.flavor: A short, ugly blade, and it knows where the armor ends.

Shove.name: Shove
Shove.flavor: You put your weight behind it and drive them back.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: The target's Size is at most 1 larger than yours.

Shriek and Scatter.name: Shriek and Scatter
Shriek and Scatter.flavor: One of them drops, and the rest remember how much they hate you.

body.label: Trigger
body.text: An ally with the Goblin Tag within 6 squares goes Down.

body.label: Effect
body.text: The goblin can Evade 1, then uses Jeer.

Skirmish Shot.name: Skirmish Shot
Skirmish Shot.flavor: Loose, and be gone before the arrow lands.

Slip Away.name: Slip Away
Slip Away.flavor: The moment a foe commits to reaching you, you are already somewhere else.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: The target would enter a square adjacent to you.

Slipping Touch.name: Slipping Touch
Slipping Touch.flavor: It reaches for you and is already somewhere else.

Smite.name: Smite
Smite.flavor: Holy light gathers on your weapon as the fight wears on, and you bring all of it down in one blow.

body.label: Smite dice
body.text: [R] 1d6! Ho for each Escalation you have, up to 4 dice. Against a Profane creature they are 1d8!s.

body.label: Tier 3
body.text: [V] 1[W] + [Mod] + your Smite dice + 1 more Smite die.

body.label: Special
body.text: When you use Smite, you can spend your Reaction Point to roll 1 more Smite die. Neither extra die counts toward the 4.

Snap Shot.name: Snap Shot
Snap Shot.flavor: A foe lunges for you, and you put an arrow in it before it has finished the step.

body.label: Interrupt
body.text: The target would enter a square adjacent to you.

Spotter.name: Spotter
Spotter.flavor: You read the field the way others read a page: where a foe hides, where the gap in its cover is, where you yourself are hardest to hit.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Your allies perceive the target one step better than they do: Hidden as Obscured, Obscured as Clear; Unsensed stays Unsensed (1 round).

body.label: Effect
body.text: Your next [Ranged, Strike] Action this turn ignores the Banes of far and maximum range, and counts each target's Cover as one level lower (Total Cover stays Total).

body.label: Effect
body.text: Against each creature you have Cover from, your Cover is one level higher, up to High (1 round).

Staggering Shot.name: Staggering Shot
Staggering Shot.flavor: The bolt knocks the wind out of them.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 3 or more, the first time each round you deal damage to your Marked Quarry with a [Projectile] Action, they are Dazed 1 and Hindered (EoT).

Stand.name: Stand
Stand.flavor: You get your feet back under you.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You stand up: you are no longer Prone.

Steady Draw.name: Steady Draw
Steady Draw.flavor: A rattled foe holds still for a heartbeat, and your second arrow follows the first.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [[Basic Attack]] gains, above its Attack line: **Strained:** Against a Strained target, a Tier 3 deals 1[D] more.

Steady Nerves.name: Steady Nerves
Steady Nerves.flavor: They are in your face. You are still calm.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [Ranged] Actions don't take the Banes for being Engaged.

Steel Yourself.name: Steel Yourself
Steel Yourself.flavor: You grit your teeth and find a little more to give.

after.label: Special
after.text: You can't use this Action while Down (Desperate, Dying or Shattered) or Unconscious.

Stick and Slip.name: Stick and Slip
Stick and Slip.flavor: In, a quick cut, and out before they can answer.

Sting.name: Sting
Sting.flavor: A small bolt in the leg: small, and enough.

Strafe.name: Strafe
Strafe.flavor: You run to a better angle and put an arrow into each of up to three foes.

Sure Step.name: Sure Step
Sure Step.flavor: Loose, step, and let them wonder where the next one comes from.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 2 or more, once a round, when you deal damage to your Marked Quarry with a [Projectile] Action, you can Evade 1.

Sworn Blade.name: Sworn Blade
Sworn Blade.flavor: Each blow you swear by turns a shaken foe where you want it.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Your [[Basic Attack]] gains: **Strained:** You can Slide the target 1.

Take Aim.name: Take Aim
Take Aim.flavor: You plant your feet, slow your breath, and let the world narrow to the arrowhead.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: You haven't left your square this turn.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Until the end of your turn (EoT), your [Ranged, Strike] Actions gain 1 Boon and take no Bane for the far range (Chapter 15). This ends when you leave your square.

Thrill of the Kill.name: Thrill of the Kill
Thrill of the Kill.flavor: One of yours drops, and your blood is up.

body.label: Passive
body.text: Once an encounter, when an enemy you have damaged goes Down, your Escalation increases by 1.

Thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
Thunderclap.flavor: The shot and the smoke, and they are on the ground.

Thwart Cut.name: Thwart Cut
Thwart Cut.flavor: You cut across your foe's blade and stay on it, and every blow it tries has to come through your steel.

body.label: Special
body.text: This Pressed ends if you stop threatening the target.

Tireless Vigil.name: Tireless Vigil
Tireless Vigil.flavor: The longer the fight lasts, the less escapes you: your guard is on two allies at once.

body.label: Passive
body.text: You gain 1 more Reaction Point when you regain AP. It pays only for [Divine] Reactions.

Trick Shots.name: Trick Shots
Trick Shots.flavor: You put the arrow where it will do something other than wound: through a cloak, past an ear, square on a shield.

Trip.name: Trip
Trip.flavor: A hooked foot, a twist, and they hit the ground.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: The target's Size is at most 1 larger than yours.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Body or Instinct vs. the same Attribute's DC

Tumble.name: Tumble
Tumble.flavor: You duck, roll and slip past them.

body.label: Special
body.text: You can move through enemies' spaces (never ending in one). Before you move, make an Appeal or Instinct Check against the same Attribute's DC of the creatures whose spaces your path crosses (the highest), with 1 Bane for each creature beyond the first: on a Tier 1 you stop in the last square before the first enemy's space and your movement ends; on a Tier 2 or 3 you pass. Passing diagonally between two enemies corner to corner counts as crossing one creature: the higher of their DCs, no Bane for the second.

Twin Shot.name: Twin Shot
Twin Shot.flavor: Two arrows, one motion, two answers.

body.label: Effect
body.text: Make one [Ranged, Projectile] Weapon Attack (1A) and compare its result to two different creatures no more than 5 squares apart. It deals an extra [V] 1d6 Pi to each of them.

Vanish.name: Vanish
Vanish.flavor: They reach for you, and you are already somewhere else.

body.label: Passive
body.text: While your Escalation is 1 or more, you have the **Vanish** Reaction (0R, Round). **Interrupt:** An enemy would enter a square adjacent to you during a Move Action. You can Evade 1.

Volley.name: Volley
Volley.flavor: You send a flight of arrows high, and they come down on everything standing in one patch of ground.

War Howl.name: War Howl
War Howl.flavor: The orc throws its head back and howls, and the sound gets into your bones.

Weight of Judgment.name: Weight of Judgment
Weight of Judgment.flavor: Your judgment hangs on your foe like a chain, and its steps drag.

body.label: Passive
body.text: A creature Judged by you has its Speed reduced by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.flavor: You spin, and everything within reach feels the blade.

Word of Radiance.name: Word of Radiance
Word of Radiance.flavor: You speak a single word of your god, and light bursts from you: your foes burn in it and stagger back.

body.label: Special
body.text: Against a Profane creature, the damage dice are d8s.

Wounding Shot.name: Wounding Shot
Wounding Shot.flavor: You hold your ground until your foe shows its flank, and put a broad-headed arrow where the wound will not close.

body.label: Requirement
body.text: You haven't left your square this turn.
